content: Root cause: The bug was caused by an incorrect calculation of the payload length for isochronous packets in the ALSA firewire-lib. The payload length did not account for the two quadlets that are part of the CIP header, leading to an invalid length being reported in tracepoint events. This oversight resulted in the payload length being set incorrectly, which could affect the handling of audio data packets. The patch corrects this by ensuring that the payload length includes both the CIP header and the actual data payload.
